content:
Government Polytechnic Khagaria has invited applications for the engagement of graduates and diploma students under the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS).

There are 5 vacancies in different branches including Mechanical, Electrical, Library, and Computer Science & Engineering.

Vacancy Details

  • Mechanical – Degree (B.Tech/B.E.) – 01
  • Electrical – Degree (B.Tech/B.E.) – 01
  • Mechanical – Diploma – 01
  • Library – Degree – 01
  • Computer Science & Engineering – Diploma – 01

Walk-in Interview Date: 15 September 2026 (Tuesday)
Reporting Time: 10:00 AM
Venue: Government Polytechnic, Khagaria, Mahaddipur, Pasraha, Bihar, Pin-851212

Important: Candidates must carry a valid NATS student ID, CV, academic documents, eligibility proof, reservation certificate if applicable, and all original documents for verification. No TA/DA is provided for the interview.
